compsdtd:section.compsdtd:header: Meat inspection, Bureau of Animal Industry:
compsdtd:section.compsdtd:text: For additional expenses in carrying out the provisions of the meat-inspection Act of June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and six (Thirty-fourth Statutes at Large, page six hundred and seventy-four), there is hereby appropriated for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and fifteen, the sum of $375,000: Provided, That the provisions of the meat-inspection law may be extended to the inspection of reindeer.
